policy_notes: Validated workflow specification BONOBO under project policy d21a33277fd0.

The verified netZooPy 0.11.0 public API is `netZooPy.bonobo.Bonobo(expression_file)` followed by `run_bonobo(output_folder, output_fmt, keep_in_memory, save_full, online_coexpression, delta, computing, cores, precision, sample_names, sparsify, confidence, save_pvals)`. The agent passes only the supported controls declared in this workflow and never invokes the BONOBO CLI.

The installed source reader uses header=0 and index_col=0, so the agent requires a labelled header: the first column is unique gene IDs and the remaining column names are unique sample IDs. A headerless matrix must be corrected before execution; the CLI's looser header description is not used as the executable contract.

Expression data must be numeric, finite, complete, gene-by-sample, and have at least three total samples so each leave-one-out background has at least two samples. The agent requires the caller to declare log_transformed=true and centered=true because BONOBO assumes log-transformed centered expression.

sample_names is an explicit list of sample IDs, never positional indices. Unknown or duplicate names are rejected before the API call and the selected names remain in manifest.json and the sample-to-file mapping.

output formats are exactly .h5/.hdf (HDF5), .txt, and .csv. Upstream writes a square matrix with gene IDs as columns and no row labels; HDF5 uses key bonobo and p-value HDF5 uses key pvals. TXT is tab-delimited and CSV is comma-delimited for the agent-owned artifact reader.

`sparsify` computes the upstream approximate p-values. With sparsify=true and save_pvals=false, upstream thresholds the co-expression matrix and does not save p-values. With both sparsify=true and save_pvals=true, upstream retains the full co-expression matrix and writes p-values for downstream thresholding; it does not also emit an already-thresholded network.

The agent rejects save_pvals=true without sparsify=true and does not claim that a p-value artifact is a GRN. Output verification is required after every run, and the manifest distinguishes a sparsification request from an actually thresholded network and from a network requiring p-value-based thresholding.

BONOBO has no aggregate/prior output. Its sample-specific matrices are not directly valid PANDA/PUMA coexpression_file inputs, which require one validated aggregate labeled gene-by-gene matrix; no implicit averaging or sample-index selection is performed.
